decision: Lock Stage-1 to normal autoregressive Qwen decoding for all five tasks and close specialist Stage-1 head routes.
rationale: The scientific object is representation transfer from a human-adapted generative VLM. Replacing its outputs with HQNet, SAM, ROI heatmaps, regression heads, or hidden-state mask decoders changes that object even when those routes improve accuracy.
evidence: Explicit user correction in the current Codex task
The dense-head pilot optimized successfully but did not test the requested architecture
KptLLM++ demonstrates direct textual coordinate decoding for keypoints
HiMTok and direct contour approaches demonstrate autoregressive mask representations without external segmentation tools
reopen_condition: Only an explicit user decision changing the Stage-1 decoder contract.
